integrity: The six-belt formula is proved analytically and a standalone implementation independently checks finite matrix identities, geometric reductions, quadrature and Monte Carlo. No claim of independent audit or exhaustive numerical proof.
limitations: Haar-uniform central orthogonal planar projections of the fixed edge-two regular icosahedron; exact formula only on the upper-diameter branch ending at the first three-band overlap. No whole-CDF, deformations or independent validation.
title: An exact upper-tail law for random icosahedral shadow diameters
